trace_observation: Public round-2 trace found and sank length-2 at cells 18,26 early, followed by a run of hunt misses. No opponent fleet inspected.
weakness: Incumbent weights using count of untried cells rather than true ship length; this changes weights as hits accumulate, and weakly values small-ship discovery.
hypothesis: Weight each consistent fleet cell inversely by its actual ship length, retaining target preference and hunt lattice, to prioritize progress on small hard-to-find ships.
